schema.name: value
schema.label: Value
schema.description: Stored verbatim on jfb_metrics.source when this option is picked. For auto sources this is the data view slug itself (e.g. 'dvw-jfb-metric-cy'), so app code can dispatch straight to usdf.<value> with no separate mapping table. The sentinel row for manual entry uses the literal value 'manual'.

schema.name: label
schema.label: Label
schema.description: Dropdown display text, e.g. "Auto · CY from production stats".

schema.name: unit
schema.label: Unit
schema.description: This source's canonical unit (CY, SF, hrs, %). Null for the manual sentinel. Lets app code auto-populate a metric row's unit from its chosen source instead of the PE typing it -- see METRICS_MIGRATION_PLAN.md §4 open question 2.

schema.name: sort_order
schema.label: Sort Order
schema.description: Display order in the source dropdown.

schema.name: result_column
schema.label: Result Column
schema.description: For a data-view-backed source, the column name that data view's function returns (e.g. 'total_volume' for dvw-jfb-metric-cy). Lets app code read the right field off the data view's response without a hardcoded slug-to-column map. Null for the manual sentinel and any source with no data view yet.

schema.name: active
schema.label: Active
schema.description: Whether this source is currently selectable. False retires a source (e.g. its data view was unpublished) without deleting history on jfb_metrics rows that already reference it. pkl-jfb-metric-source filters on this being true.

schema.name: description
schema.label: Description
schema.description: Optional note surfaced in the dropdown, e.g. a "pending DB" caveat for a source with no real data yet.
